## Simulate Null (Bootstrapped)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

#for one player

prep_null_inputs_shai <- function(nba) {
  # observed per-game event counts (nonzero, non-NA dPerf)
  k_by_game <- nba %>%
    filter(!is.na(dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander), dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander != 0) %>%
    count(game_id, name = "k") %>%
    pull(k)

  # season-wide pool of score changes
  dperf_pool <- nba %>%
    filter(!is.na(dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander), dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander != 0) %>%
    pull(dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander)

  # number of games present in the dataset
  n_games_in_nba <- nba %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(game_id)) %>% pull(n)

  list(k_by_game = k_by_game, dperf_pool = dperf_pool, n_games_in_nba = n_games_in_nba)
}

simulate_one_null_game <- function(k_by_game, dperf_pool, sim_game,
                                  t0 = 0, t1 = 48, start_perf = 0) {
  k <- sample(k_by_game, size = 1)                # uniform over observed k's
  times <- sort(runif(k, min = t0, max = t1))     # event times
  dperf <- sample(dperf_pool, size = k, replace = TRUE)

  tibble(
    sim_game = sim_game,
    event_id = seq_len(k),
    game_time_min = times,
    sim_dPerf = dperf
  )
}

simulate_null_season_shai <- function(nba, n_games = NULL,
                                      t0 = 0, t1 = 48, start_perf = 0) {
  inp <- prep_null_inputs_shai(nba)


  # ALL games in nba: leave n_games = NULL
  # exactly 100: set n_games = 100
  if (is.null(n_games)) n_games <- inp$n_games_in_nba

  map_dfr(seq_len(n_games), ~simulate_one_null_game(
    k_by_game = inp$k_by_game,
    dperf_pool = inp$dperf_pool,
    sim_game = .x,
    t0 = t0, t1 = t1,
    start_perf = start_perf
  ))
}


# simulate x number games
#null_games_82 <- simulate_null_season_shai(nba, n_games = 82)

# simulate the whole dataset (# unique game_id in nba)
null_games_all <- simulate_null_season_shai(nba, n_games = 100)   

```

```{r}
g2 <- null_games_all %>%

  mutate(sim_Perf = cumsum(sim_dPerf))

ggplot(g2, aes(x = game_time_min, y = sim_Perf)) +
```

```{r}
null_perf_all <- null_games_all %>%
  arrange(sim_game, game_time_min, event_id) %>%
  group_by(sim_game) %>%
  mutate(sim_Perf = cumsum(sim_dPerf)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(null_perf_all,
       aes(game_time_min,
           sim_Perf,
           group = sim_game)) +
  geom_step(alpha = 0.15) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Game time (min)",
       y = "Null cumulative performance")
```

```{r}
#linear model
trend_coefs <- null_perf_all %>%
  group_by(sim_game) %>%
  do({
    fit <- lm(sim_Perf ~ game_time_min, data = .)
    tibble(
      intercept = coef(fit)[1],
      slope = coef(fit)[2]
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#upper and lower bounds and slopes
lower_int  <- quantile(trend_coefs$intercept, 0.05) #0.025 0.05
upper_int  <- quantile(trend_coefs$intercept, 0.95) #0.975 0.95

lower_slope <- quantile(trend_coefs$slope, 0.05)
upper_slope <- quantile(trend_coefs$slope, 0.95)


#build lines
time_grid <- seq(min(null_perf_all$game_time_min),
                 max(null_perf_all$game_time_min),
                 length.out = 200)

trend_lines <- tibble(
  game_time_min = time_grid,
  lower_line = lower_int + lower_slope * time_grid,
  upper_line = upper_int + upper_slope * time_grid
)


#plot
ggplot() +
  # null games
  geom_step(data = null_perf_all,
            aes(game_time_min, sim_Perf, group = sim_game),
            alpha = 0.15) +
  # lower 95 trend line
  geom_line(data = trend_lines,
            aes(game_time_min, lower_line),
            color = "red",
            linewidth = .7) +
  # upper 95 trend line
  geom_line(data = trend_lines,
            aes(game_time_min, upper_line),
            color = "red",
            linewidth = .7) +

  theme_minimal() +
 labs(
    title = "Simulated Null Distribution for Shai",
    x = "Game Time (Minutes)",
    y = "Null Cumulative Performance"
  )

```

## 90% Confidence Bounds over Real games

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# time grid for the two null trend lines
time_grid <- seq(
  min(nba$game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(nba$game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

trend_lines_obs <- tibble(
  game_time_min = time_grid,
  lower_line = lower_int + lower_slope * game_time_min,
  upper_line = upper_int + upper_slope * game_time_min
)


#filter any games not playing
shai_games <- nba %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander) &
             dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander != 0)) %>%
  ungroup()


# plot Shai observed perf with null bounds
ggplot() +
  geom_step(data = shai_games,
            aes(game_time_min,
                Perf_shai_gilgeous_alexander,
                group = game_id),
            alpha = 0.15,
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = trend_lines_obs,
            aes(game_time_min, lower_line),
            color = "red",
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = trend_lines_obs,
            aes(game_time_min, upper_line),
            color = "red",
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Observed Shai Performance with Null 90% Trend Bounds",
    x = "Game Time (Minutes)",
    y = "Performance Score"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
  str_subset("^Perf_") %>%

filter_player_games <- function(data, player, threshold = 10){

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  data %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > threshold) %>%
    ungroup()
}

```

```{r}
#bootstrap null per player
set.seed(1234)
simulate_null_player <- function(data, player){

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  # distribution inputs
  k_by_game <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    count(game_id) %>%
    pull(n)

  dperf_pool <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    pull(.data[[dperf_col]])

  # simulate
  map_dfr(seq_along(unique(data$game_id)), function(g){

    k <- sample(k_by_game, 1)

    tibble(
      player = player,
      sim_game = g,
      event_id = seq_len(k),
      game_time_min = sort(runif(k,0,48)),
      sim_dPerf = sample(dperf_pool, k, replace=TRUE)
    )

  })
}

```

```{r}
#build nulls
build_null_perf <- function(null_df){

  null_df %>%
    arrange(player, sim_game, game_time_min) %>%
    group_by(player, sim_game) %>%
    mutate(sim_Perf = cumsum(sim_dPerf)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

```

```{r}
#get bounds
get_trend_bounds <- function(null_perf){

  coefs <- null_perf %>%
    group_by(player, sim_game) %>%
    do({
      fit <- lm(sim_Perf ~ game_time_min, data=.)
      tibble(
        intercept = coef(fit)[1],
        slope = coef(fit)[2]
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  coefs %>%
    group_by(player) %>%
    summarise(
      lower_int = quantile(intercept, .05),
      upper_int = quantile(intercept, .95),
      lower_slope = quantile(slope, .05),
      upper_slope = quantile(slope, .95)
    )
}

```

```{r}
library(purrr)

results <- map(players, function(p){

  cat("Processing:", p, "\n")

  filtered <- filter_player_games(nba_full, p, threshold = 10)

  null_events <- simulate_null_player(filtered, p)

  null_perf <- build_null_perf(null_events)

  bounds <- get_trend_bounds(null_perf)

  list(
    player = p,
    null_perf = null_perf,
    bounds = bounds
  )

})
```

```{r}
#detect games and times when plyers cross line
library(dplyr)

detect_heat_intervals_compact <- function(player_name, real_long, all_bounds, digits = 2) {

  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    select(upper_int, upper_slope) %>%
    slice(1)

  upper_int   <- b$upper_int
  upper_slope <- b$upper_slope

  intervals_long <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(upper_line = upper_int + upper_slope * game_time_min,
           above = obs_perf > upper_line) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above)))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(game_id, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in  = min(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      t_out = max(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  intervals_long %>%
    mutate(
      t_in  = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "\u2013", t_out)
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(game_id)
}

```

```{r}
#heat area under curve, above line
detect_heat_area <- function(player_name, real_long, all_bounds){

  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  upper_int   <- b$upper_int
  upper_slope <- b$upper_slope

  real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = upper_int + upper_slope * game_time_min,
      excess = obs_perf - upper_line
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trapezoid_area = ifelse(
        excess > 0 & lag(excess) > 0,
        ((excess + lag(excess)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      total_heat_area = sum(trapezoid_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_heat_time = sum(ifelse(excess > 0 & lag(excess) > 0, dt, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(total_heat_area > 0) %>%   # keeps only real heat games
    arrange(desc(total_heat_area))
}

```

```{r}
})

heat_area_all %>%

  filter(total_heat_area > 0) %>%
```

```{r}
#hot area and time with interval times for games
detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact <- function(player_name, real_long, all_bounds, digits = 1, area_digits = 2){

  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  upper_int   <- b$upper_int
  upper_slope <- b$upper_slope

  blocks <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = upper_int + upper_slope * game_time_min,
      excess = obs_perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above),
        ((excess + lag(excess)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(game_id, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in  = min(game_time_min),
      t_out = max(game_time_min),
      area  = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in  = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area  = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  blocks %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(game_id)
}

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

make_key <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[’']", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_")
}

heat_tables <- heat_tables %>%
  mutate(player_key = make_key(player))

pos_df <- tibble(
  player = names(player_positions),
  position = player_positions
) %>%
  mutate(player_key = make_key(player)) %>%
  select(player_key, position)

heat_tables <- heat_tables %>%
  left_join(pos_df, by = "player_key") %>%
  select(-player_key)
```

```{r}
for(i in 1:nrow(top10_games)){

  p  <- top10_games$player[i]
  g  <- top10_games$game_id[i]
  area_val <- round(top10_games$total_heat_area[i], 2)
  time_val <- round(top10_games$total_heat_time[i], 2)

  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    slice(1)

  #real game
  game_data <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == p, game_id == g) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  if(nrow(game_data) > 0){

    game_data <- game_data %>%
      mutate(
        upper_line = b$upper_int + b$upper_slope * game_time_min,
        lower_line = b$lower_int + b$lower_slope * game_time_min,
        above = obs_perf > upper_line,
        shade_ymin = upper_line,
        shade_ymax = ifelse(above, obs_perf, upper_line)  # only shade when above
      )

    print(
      ggplot(game_data, aes(game_time_min, obs_perf)) +

        # shaded region above upper bound
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = shade_ymin, ymax = shade_ymax),
                    alpha = 0.25) +

        # observed line (normal width)
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +

        # bounds
        geom_line(aes(y = upper_line), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
        geom_line(aes(y = lower_line), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +

        theme_minimal() +
        labs(
          title = paste("Player:", p),
          subtitle = paste("Game ID:", g, "| Total Heat Area:", area_val, "| Total Heat Minutes:", time_val),
          x = "Game Time (minutes)",
          y = "Cumulative Performance"
        )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#all hot games for a player
plot_all_hot_games <- function(player_name, real_long, all_bounds, heat_tables){

  # games where this player had heat
  hot_games <- heat_tables %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    pull(game_id) %>%
    unique()

  # bounds once
  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  for(g in hot_games){

    # grab this game's heat stats
    stats_g <- heat_tables %>%
      filter(player == player_name, game_id == g) %>%
      slice(1)

    area_val <- round(stats_g$total_heat_area, 2)
    time_val <- round(stats_g$total_heat_time, 2)

    game_data <- real_long %>%
      filter(player == player_name, game_id == g) %>%
      arrange(game_time_min)

    if(nrow(game_data) > 0){

      game_data <- game_data %>%
        mutate(
          upper_line = b$upper_int + b$upper_slope * game_time_min,
          lower_line = b$lower_int + b$lower_slope * game_time_min,
          shade_ymin = upper_line,
          shade_ymax = ifelse(obs_perf > upper_line, obs_perf, upper_line)
        )

      print(
        ggplot(game_data, aes(game_time_min, obs_perf)) +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = shade_ymin, ymax = shade_ymax), alpha = 0.25) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
          geom_line(aes(y = upper_line), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
          geom_line(aes(y = lower_line), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
          theme_minimal() +
          labs(
            title = paste("Hot Game —", player_name),
            subtitle = paste("Game ID:", g,
                             "| Total Heat Area:", area_val,
                             "| Minutes Above Bound:", time_val),
            x = "Game Time (minutes)",
            y = "Cumulative Performance"
          )
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# Build per-bin distributions of event counts across games
estimate_bin_count_distributions <- function(data, dperf_col, bin_width = 2, time_col = "game_time_min") {

  bins <- seq(0, 48 - bin_width, by = bin_width)

  # count events per (game, bin)
  counts <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    mutate(bin_start = floor(.data[[time_col]] / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
    filter(bin_start %in% bins) %>%
    count(game_id, bin_start, name = "k_bin")

  # ensure every game has a 0 for bins with no events
  all_games <- data %>% distinct(game_id)
  full_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(all_games, bin_start = bins)

  counts_full <- full_grid %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c("game_id", "bin_start")) %>%
    mutate(k_bin = ifelse(is.na(k_bin), 0L, k_bin))

  # list-column: for each bin_start, store vector of k_bin across games
  bin_k_list <- counts_full %>%
    group_by(bin_start) %>%
    summarise(k_values = list(k_bin), .groups = "drop")

  bin_k_list
}

# Simulate one null game using per-bin event counts
simulate_one_null_game_binned <- function(bin_k_list, dperf_pool, bin_width = 2) {

  # sample counts per bin and generate times within bins
  sim_times <- bin_k_list %>%
    mutate(
      k = map_int(k_values, ~ sample(.x, 1)),
      bin_end = pmin(bin_start + bin_width, 48),
      times = map2(bin_start, k, ~ if(.y == 0) numeric(0) else runif(.y, min = .x, max = .x + bin_width))
    ) %>%
    pull(times) %>%
    unlist()

  sim_times <- sort(sim_times)
  k_total <- length(sim_times)

  if(k_total == 0){
    return(tibble(event_id = integer(0), game_time_min = numeric(0), sim_dPerf = numeric(0), sim_perf = numeric(0)))
  }

  sim_dperf <- sample(dperf_pool, size = k_total, replace = TRUE)
  sim_perf  <- cumsum(sim_dperf)

  tibble(
    event_id = seq_len(k_total),
    game_time_min = sim_times,
    sim_dPerf = sim_dperf,
    sim_perf = sim_perf
  )
}

# Simulate many null games for one player-column
simulate_null_games_binned <- function(data, dperf_col, n_sims = 100, bin_width = 2, time_col = "game_time_min") {

  # pool of increments (season-wide, nonzero)
  dperf_pool <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    pull(.data[[dperf_col]])

  # per-bin distributions of event counts
  bin_k_list <- estimate_bin_count_distributions(data, dperf_col, bin_width, time_col)

  map_dfr(seq_len(n_sims), function(s){
    simulate_one_null_game_binned(bin_k_list, dperf_pool, bin_width) %>%
      mutate(sim_game = s) %>%
      select(sim_game, everything())
  })
}

# example

null_games_all_bin_shai
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

simulate_null_player_binned <- function(data, player, bin_width = 2, game_length = 48) {

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  # add bin column (0..23 for 48 mins with 2-min bins)
  dat <- data %>%
    filter(game_time_min >= 0, game_time_min <= game_length) %>%
    mutate(
      bin = floor(game_time_min / bin_width),
      bin = pmin(bin, floor((game_length - 1e-9) / bin_width)) # keep 48 exactly from becoming bin 24
    )

  # pooled dPerf distribution (same as before)
  dperf_pool <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    pull(.data[[dperf_col]])

  # empirical distribution of event counts per bin across games
  # for each bin, we store a vector of counts (one per game, including 0s)
  games <- sort(unique(dat$game_id))
  bins  <- 0:floor((game_length - 1e-9) / bin_width)

  k_by_bin <- map(bins, function(b) {
    dat %>%
      filter(bin == b, !is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
      count(game_id, name = "k") %>%
      right_join(tibble(game_id = games), by = "game_id") %>%
      mutate(k = replace_na(k, 0L)) %>%
      pull(k)
  })
  names(k_by_bin) <- as.character(bins)

  # simulate one "season" of null games (same number of games as input data has)
  sim_games <- seq_along(unique(dat$game_id))

  map_dfr(sim_games, function(g) {

    map_dfr(bins, function(b) {

      k_vec <- k_by_bin[[as.character(b)]]
      if (length(k_vec) == 0) k_vec <- 0L

      k <- sample(k_vec, 1)

      if (k == 0) {
        return(tibble(
          player = player,
          sim_game = g,
          bin = b,
          event_id = integer(0),
          game_time_min = numeric(0),
          sim_dPerf = numeric(0)
        ))
      }

      bin_start <- b * bin_width
      bin_end   <- min((b + 1) * bin_width, game_length)

      tibble(
        player = player,
        sim_game = g,
        bin = b,
        event_id = seq_len(k),
        game_time_min = sort(runif(k, bin_start, bin_end)),
        sim_dPerf = sample(dperf_pool, k, replace = TRUE)
      )
    })

  })
}
```

```{r}
#get bounds_binned (new bounds: edit once you got new one)
get_trend_bounds_bin <- function(null_perf){

  coefs <- null_perf %>%
    group_by(player, sim_game) %>%
    do({
      fit <- lm(sim_Perf ~ game_time_min, data=.)
      tibble(
        intercept = coef(fit)[1],
        slope = coef(fit)[2]
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  coefs %>%
    group_by(player) %>%
    summarise(
      lower_int = quantile(intercept, .05),
      upper_int = quantile(intercept, .95),
      lower_slope = quantile(slope, .05),
      upper_slope = quantile(slope, .95)
    )
}
```

```{r}
results <- map(players, function(p){

  cat("Processing:", p, "\n")

  filtered <- filter_player_games(nba_full, p, threshold = 10)

  null_events <- simulate_null_player_binned(filtered, p, bin_width = 2, game_length = 48)

  null_perf <- build_null_perf(null_events)

  bounds <- get_trend_bounds_bin(null_perf)

  list(
    player = p,
    null_perf = null_perf,
    bounds = bounds
  )

})
```

```{r}
detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact <- function(player_name, real_long, all_bounds, digits = 1, area_digits = 2){

  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  upper_int   <- b$upper_int
  upper_slope <- b$upper_slope

  blocks <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = upper_int + upper_slope * game_time_min,
      excess = obs_perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above),
        ((excess + lag(excess)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(game_id, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in  = min(game_time_min),
      t_out = max(game_time_min),
      area  = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in  = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area  = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  blocks %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(game_id)
}
```


```{r}
for(i in 1:nrow(top10_games_bin)){

  p  <- top10_games_bin$player[i]
  g  <- top10_games_bin$game_id[i]
  area_val <- round(top10_games_bin$total_heat_area[i], 2)
  time_val <- round(top10_games_bin$total_heat_time[i], 2)

  b <- all_bounds %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    slice(1)

  #real game
  game_data <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == p, game_id == g) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  if(nrow(game_data) > 0){

    game_data <- game_data %>%
      mutate(
        upper_line = b$upper_int + b$upper_slope * game_time_min,
        lower_line = b$lower_int + b$lower_slope * game_time_min,
        above = obs_perf > upper_line,
        shade_ymin = upper_line,
        shade_ymax = ifelse(above, obs_perf, upper_line)  # only shade when above
      )

    print(
      ggplot(game_data, aes(game_time_min, obs_perf)) +

        # shaded region above upper bound
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = shade_ymin, ymax = shade_ymax),
                    alpha = 0.25) +

        # observed line (normal width)
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +

        # bounds
        geom_line(aes(y = upper_line), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
        geom_line(aes(y = lower_line), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +

        theme_minimal() +
        labs(
          title = paste("Player:", p),
          subtitle = paste("Game ID:", g, "| Total Heat Area:", area_val, "| Total Heat Minutes:", time_val),
          x = "Game Time (minutes)",
          y = "Cumulative Performance"
        )
    )
  }
}
```
